Bathroom Remodeling in Haysville, KS

Haysville's housing stock runs heavy 1970s through 1990s — the bedroom community south of Wichita that grew steadily as Derby and the south suburbs expanded. These homes were built solidly and they've aged well in the structural sense. The bathrooms are a different story.

The 1970s Haysville bathroom was fiberglass over a steel tub, ceramic tile in a small format on the floor, a builder oak vanity, and an exhaust fan that might have worked once. The 1980s version swapped in cultured marble and improved the tile options slightly. The 1990s version added more fiberglass. None of them have aged particularly well and most are significantly overdue for renovation.

Wheatland Construction remodels bathrooms in Haysville and south Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018.

Haysville Bathroom Remodeling Context

Arkansas River corridor: Haysville's position in the Arkansas River drainage creates moisture conditions that older south Wichita homes feel more than newer construction further north. If bathroom exhaust fans have been inadequate for years, the subfloor under the original fiberglass and the wall cavity behind it may have absorbed moisture over time. We check these conditions before closing new tile over existing damage.

1970s–1980s plumbing: Haysville homes from this era were typically plumbed in copper — a significant advantage over galvanized. ABS plastic drain lines in this vintage are generally in acceptable condition. We still assess before closing walls.

Common remodel scopes in Haysville: The most frequent ask in Haysville is a full primary bath conversion — demo the original fiberglass tub/shower combo, build a walk-in tile shower, replace the vanity, update fixtures and lighting. We've done a lot of them.

Permits in Haysville

City of Haysville Building Department for homes inside city limits. We handle all permit applications and inspections.

How We Approach Bathroom Remodeling in

Every bathroom remodel in starts with an in-person assessment. We walk the existing bathroom with you, look at what's behind the walls where it matters (around the tub/shower surround, under the vanity, at the subfloor where it meets the tub), and give you an honest read on what the project actually involves before any numbers get discussed.

We price in writing. Every line item - demo, plumbing, tile, vanity, fixtures, exhaust, permit - is documented before work starts. No surprises mid-project.

Our crew handles demo through final walkthrough. We don't hand off your project to a rotating cast of subcontractors who don't know each other's work. The people who pull the permits are the people who do the work and stand behind it.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas. If something isn't right at the final walkthrough, we fix it before we consider the project done.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Remodeling in Haysville

How much does bathroom remodeling cost in Haysville, KS?

Haysville bathroom remodels range from $8,000 for a guest bath refresh to $25,000+ for a full primary bath renovation with walk-in shower conversion, new vanity, and updated electrical. Most full primary bath conversions in Haysville run $13,000–$20,000. Written, line-item estimates.

Do I need permits for bathroom remodeling in Haysville?

Plumbing and electrical work requires permits through the City of Haysville Building Department. We handle all permit applications and scheduling.

Should I check for moisture damage before remodeling my Haysville bathroom?

Yes — especially in homes where the original fiberglass surround has had caulk failures over the years and the exhaust fan hasn't been adequate. We assess the subfloor and wall cavity condition as part of the consultation. Better to know before demo than after.

How long does a Haysville bathroom remodel take?

2–4 weeks for most projects. Walk-in shower conversions with full tile work may run 3–5 weeks.

What's the most popular bathroom remodel scope in Haysville?

Walk-in shower conversion in the primary bath, combined with a new quartz vanity top and updated fixtures. This single scope transforms the most-used bathroom in the home and is the best return on bathroom remodeling investment.

Does bathroom remodeling add value in Haysville?

Yes. South Sedgwick County has appreciated steadily and Haysville properties benefit from the metro's growth southward. An updated primary bathroom is a top value driver in Haysville's resale market.
